questions.question:
D6 — E1: Add project-shared views to this plan?
Project/branch/task: main branch, saved views under approach B, SCOPE EXPANSION mode.
ELI10: Right now every saved view is private to the member who made it. Shared views let a member flip a view to "visible to this project" so teammates see and apply it from the same picker. Only the owner (or a project admin) can edit or delete it; everyone else gets a read-only copy they can "Save as mine". Approach B already has the visibility column, so this is the endpoint authorization rules, the picker section, and the ownership tests.
Stakes if we pick wrong: skip it and the team keeps recreating the lead's filters by hand, which is the exact pain the plan set out to remove, just moved one person over. Add it and the authorization surface doubles, which is the riskiest part of the feature.
Recommendation: A because this is the single expansion that turns a personal shortcut into a team tool, and the column already exists; the real cost is tests, which CC makes cheap.
Completeness: A=10/10, B=7/10, C=7/10
Net: doubled authorization surface now vs the feature staying single-player and needing a second launch later.

options.label: A) Add to scope (recommended)
options.description: human ~2 days / CC ~30 min. ✅ Leads save a view once and the whole project sees it; the core pain disappears for everyone, not one person. ✅ Visibility column and soft delete already exist under approach B, so no migration later. ❌ Doubles the authorization matrix: owner vs member vs non-member on read, update, delete, and apply, each needing tests.

options.label: B) Defer to TODOS.md
options.description: ✅ Pilot stays single-player and simpler to measure. ✅ Visibility column ships now so the follow-up is endpoints and UI only. ❌ The most common team request lands in the backlog on day one.

options.label: C) Skip
options.description: ✅ Smallest authorization surface possible. ✅ Nothing to explain about who can see what. ❌ Contradicts the 10x vision you just chose; sharing would need a fresh design later.
